story_description: As a developer, I need a Swift adapter that communicates with the Codex app-server via bidirectional stdio JSON-RPC so that Blaze can send prompts and receive streaming responses without HTTP transport.
task: Build CodexThreadManager for thread lifecycle operations
task_description: Create CodexThreadManager class that wraps the four core thread JSON-RPC methods: thread/list to fetch all threads, thread/start to create new threads, thread/resume to restore existing threads, and thread/archive to archive threads. Filter threads client-side by workspace cwd. Store threadId in Session model.
atom_description: Implement CodexThreadManager actor with: (1) thread/list paginated fetching with cursor support, (2) client-side filtering by workspace.path matching thread.cwd, (3) thread/start with cwd and approvalPolicy params returning threadId, (4) thread/resume to restore thread with full turn history, (5) thread/archive to remove thread from active list, (6) threadId storage in Session model for continuity across app restarts.
problem_statement: Codex uses a workspace-to-thread hierarchy where each workspace can have multiple conversation threads. Threads are persisted server-side by Codex and must be fetched, filtered, and managed by the harness. Without CodexThreadManager, Blaze cannot list existing threads for a workspace, create new threads, resume previous conversations, or archive completed threads. This atom bridges the gap between Codex server-side thread storage and Blaze local session management.
